features.description: Large boss, outer diameter 60, height 20. Its top face carries the pins and it contains the keyed bore.
features.location: S1: axis X40 Y40 (work_origin, HUMAN_APPROVED); top face Z-4, bottom face Z-24
features.source: Top view callout Ø60; front view callout 20 (left)

features.description: Bore D30 through the large boss, coaxial with F01. The callout is underlined (ISO convention: not drawn to scale).
features.location: S1: axis X40 Y40, Z-4 to Z-24
features.source: Top view callout Ø30 (underlined); section B-B shows the bore through the full boss height

features.description: Keyway in the D30 bore, width 8, bottom 18 from the bore axis (3 beyond the bore wall), through the boss height, pointing +Y. Drawn with sharp internal corners.
features.location: S1: walls X36 and X44, bottom at Y58, Z-4 to Z-24
features.source: Section C-C callout 8 (keyway width); section B-B callout 18 (from axis)

features.description: Six pins D3.5, 4 high, on the top face of the large boss. Centres are on radius 23 from the boss axis. The layout is read as six equally spaced at 30 + k*60 deg, with one on +Y (the keyway side).
features.source: Top view callout Ø3,5; section B-B callouts 4 and 23; isometric view

features.description: Small boss, outer diameter 42, height 20. Top and bottom faces are in the same planes as F01 (front view).
features.location: S1: axis on Y40 at X = 40 + d. The centre distance d is NOT DIMENSIONED. Top Z-4, bottom Z-24.
features.source: Top view callout Ø42; front view callout 20 (right)

features.description: Bore D20 through the small boss, coaxial with F05
features.location: S1: axis X = 40 + d (unknown), Y40; Z-4 to Z-24
features.source: Top view callout Ø20; section A-A

features.description: Outer arm on the +Y side between the bosses. Convex outer edge R115, radial width 8, thickness 10. The edge appears internally tangent to both bosses (no edge line is drawn at the junctions).
features.location: Between F01 and F05, +Y side; arc centre not dimensioned (on the -Y side of the boss axis line)
features.source: Top view callouts R115 and 8 (upper); section B-B callout 10; section A-A

features.description: Inner arm. Its lower edge is a concave arc R60 that appears externally tangent to both bosses. Width 8, thickness 10.
features.location: Between F01 and F05, -Y side; arc centre not dimensioned (on the -Y side)
features.source: Top view callouts R60 and 8 (lower), leader carried down to C-C

features.description: Opening between the two arms, through the arm thickness. It is bounded by the arm inner edges and the D60 and D42 boss walls, with four R8 corner blends.
features.location: Between the bosses at arm level
features.source: Section C-C (4x R8 callouts); top view; isometric view

features.description: Arms 10 thick, drawn centred in the 20 boss height. The offset from the boss faces is not dimensioned.
features.location: Assumed S1 Z-9 to Z-19 (S2 Z-5 to Z-15)
features.source: Section B-B callout 10; front view; section A-A (layout only)

features.description: R2 concave fillets where the arm top and bottom faces meet the boss walls
features.location: Arm/D60 junction and arm/D42 junction, top and bottom of arms
features.source: Front view R2 (2x); section A-A R2 (2x)

features.description: Top faces of both bosses, 4 below the pin tops. Overall height 20 + 4 = 24, equal to the stock height, so Z0 (block top) = pin tops.
features.location: S1 Z-4 (top faces); S2 Z0 (bottom faces)
features.source: Section B-B callout 4; front view callouts 20

features.description: Break all sharp edges and remove burrs. No tolerances, surface-finish value, material or title are entered on the drawing.

unclear_or_missing.item: Centre distance d between the D60 and D42 boss axes
unclear_or_missing.why: There is no horizontal dimension in the top view, front view or C-C. Scaling is not allowed, so the position of F05, F06, F07, F08 and F09 cannot be fixed.

unclear_or_missing.item: Centres of arcs R115 and R60
unclear_or_missing.why: Not dimensioned. Tangency to the bosses is only implied (no junction edge lines). Even if tangency is confirmed, the centres still need d.

unclear_or_missing.item: Height position of the 10-thick arms within the 20 boss height
unclear_or_missing.why: Only the thickness 10 is given. The centred position is read from the layout, not from a dimension.
Each 8 callout is measured at one place. It is not stated whether the inner edges are concentric offsets (R107, R68).
The Ø3,5 callout has no '6x' and there are no angular dimensions. Six pins at 60 deg spacing with one on +Y is read from the view symmetry.

unclear_or_missing.item: Meaning of 23 and 18 in section B-B
unclear_or_missing.why: Read as axis-to-pin-centre (23) and axis-to-keyway-bottom (18). The extension lines are close together and both start at the boss axis.
Sharp internal corners cannot be produced by a rotating end mill; a D6 tool leaves R3. No width tolerance or fit is given.
Not stated. They are assumed integral because overall height 24 equals the stock height.

unclear_or_missing.item: Extent of R2 fillets and of plan-view blends at the arm/boss junctions
unclear_or_missing.why: R2 is shown only in the front view and A-A. Thin tangent lines in the top view suggest blends, but these are not dimensioned.
These title-block fields are empty. Material is taken from the approved configuration (Al 6061).
Configuration says Z0 = block top, nothing faced. This matches pin tops only because 20 + 4 = 24 = stock height.
